title: Tiered priority bands for lug dispatch — urgency field with ROI within tiers
summary: Add an urgency value (1-5) to lugs. 1=immediate/on-the-fly build, 3=Gardener schedule (default), 5=after everything else. Bypasses scheduled windows for urgent blockers.
why_bother: Unblocks workflow when encountering urgent dependencies — enables on-the-fly builds instead of waiting for the next Gardener window.
goal: Expedite critical lugs past scheduled windows; enable Ozi/Gardener to prioritize by urgency.
scope: Urgency field on lug schema (1-5, default 3). Ozi picks up urgency=1 immediately. Gardener respects urgency in scheduling order. Multi-project: Minder and framework both benefit.
constraints: Urgency integrates with existing Gardener scheduling — minimal disruption
Default=3 is backward compatible (no field = normal schedule)
urgency=1 bypasses scheduled window but still requires valid lug

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Feature lug from Minder: urgency flag for lug prioritization
_behavior_directive.processing_agent: Framework team reviews and integrates into lug schema + Gardener
_behavior_directive.expected_outcome: Urgent lugs bypass scheduled windows; blocking issues resolved faster

description: Add urgency/tier field (1–5, default 3) to lug schema. Tiers act as priority bands: all tier-1 items before any tier-2, ROI scoring applies within each band. urgency=1 (URGENT) surfaces immediately regardless of ROI. urgency=5 (DEFER) processed last. Replaces flat ROI list with banded dispatch order in Ozi and Gardener.
perceive: score_backlog.py produces a flat ROI-sorted list. No concept of priority bands. An urgent blocker with ROI 2.0 loses to a routine feature with ROI 5.0. Lug schema has no urgency field — default assumed normal. Gardener scheduling has no tier awareness.
execute: 1. Add urgency field to lug schema reference (wai-lug-schema.md): integer 1–5, default 3. Bands: 1=URGENT (immediate), 2=HIGH, 3=NORMAL (default), 4=LOW, 5=DEFER. 2. Update score_backlog.py: sort key becomes (urgency, -roi) — tier ascending, ROI descending within tier. 3. Update display in score_backlog.py: show tier band headers between groups. 4. Ozi Step 9b execute loop: respect tier order — all tier-1 before tier-2 items. 5. Document in wai-lug-schema-reference.md.
verify: python3 tools/score_backlog.py: URGENT lug with ROI 2.0 appears before NORMAL lug with ROI 5.0. Within NORMAL band, ROI order preserved. Lug with no urgency field treated as tier 3. wai-lug-schema.md documents the urgency field.
acceptance_criteria: urgency field (1–5, default 3) in lug schema reference
score_backlog.py sorts (tier asc, ROI desc) — tier bands shown in output
URGENT lug with low ROI ranks above NORMAL lug with high ROI
Step 9b execute loop respects tier order
Backward compatible: lugs without urgency treated as tier 3
